name: Transcom, Inc.
summary: Transcom, Inc. operates as a microwave device and subsystem company in Taiwan. The company offers amplifiers(GaN), including amplifiers(GaN); drone/UAV, high-power SSPA modules; C-UAS/Jammer/EW; high-power SSPA modules; GaN solid-state power amplifiers(CW), and GaN solid-state power; amplifier; MIC module; subsystem; FET chip, such as super lower noise GaAs FETs (Gallium Arsenide Field Effect Transistor), and high linearity and high efficiency GaAs Power FETs; packaged FET; monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMIC); hybrid ICs; directional couplers; power dividers; fixed attenuators and termination products; and MIC chip capacitors; as well as technical support.
